options.name: progression_dungeons
options.description:
This controls whether dungeons can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, dungeons will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_tingle_chests
options.description:
Tingle Chests that are hidden in dungeons and must be bombed to make them appear. (2 in DRC, 1 each in FW, TotG, ET, and WT).
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_dungeon_secrets
options.description:
DRC, FW, TotG, ET, and WT each have 2-3 secret items within them (11 in total). This controls whether they can be progress items.
The items are fairly well-hidden (they aren't in chests), so don't select this option unless you're prepared to search each dungeon high and low!

options.name: progression_puzzle_secret_caves
options.description:
This controls whether puzzle-focused secret caves can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_combat_secret_caves
options.description:
This controls whether combat-focused secret caves (besides Savage Labyrinth) can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_savage_labyrinth
options.description:
This controls whether the Savage Labyrinth can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, it will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_great_fairies
options.description:
This controls whether the items given by Great Fairies can be progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_short_sidequests
options.description:
This controls whether sidequests that can be completed quickly can reward progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only reward optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_long_sidequests
options.description:
This controls whether long sidequests (e.g. Lenzo's assistant, withered trees, goron trading) can reward progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only reward optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_spoils_trading
options.description:
This controls whether the items you get by trading in spoils to NPCs can be progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only reward optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_minigames
options.description:
This controls whether most minigames can reward progress items (auctions, mail sorting, barrel shooting, bird-man contest).
If this is not checked, minigames will still be randomized, but will only reward optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_battlesquid
options.description:
This controls whether the Windfall battleship minigame can reward progress items.
If this is not checked, it will still be randomized, but will only reward optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_free_gifts
options.description:
This controls whether gifts freely given by NPCs can be progress items (Tott, Salvage Corp, imprisoned Tingle).
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only be optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_mail
options.description:
This controls whether mail can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, mail will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_platforms_rafts
options.description:
This controls whether lookout platforms and rafts can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_submarines
options.description:
This controls whether submarines can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, submarines will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_eye_reef_chests
options.description:
This controls whether the chests that appear after clearing out the eye reefs can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_big_octos_gunboats
options.description:
This controls whether the items dropped by Big Octos and Gunboats can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_triforce_charts
options.description:
This controls whether the sunken treasure chests marked on Triforce Charts can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_treasure_charts
options.description:
This controls whether the sunken treasure chests marked on Treasure Charts can contain progress items.
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_expensive_purchases
options.description:
This controls whether items that cost a lot of rupees can be progress items (Rock Spire shop, auctions, Tingle's letter, trading quest).
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only be optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_island_puzzles
options.description:
This controls whether various island puzzles can contain progress items (e.g. chests hidden in unusual places).
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: progression_misc
options.description:
Miscellaneous locations that don't fit into any of the above categories (outdoors chests, wind shrine, Cyclos, etc).
If this is not checked, they will still be randomized, but will only contain optional items you don't need to beat the game.

options.name: randomize_mapcompass
options.description: Controls how dungeon maps and compasses are randomized.
choice_descriptions: Start With Maps & Compasses: You will start the game with the dungeon maps and compasses for all dungeons.
Vanilla Maps & Compasses: Dungeon maps and compasses will be kept in their vanilla location (non-randomized).
Own Dungeon Maps & Compasses: Dungeon maps and compasses will be randomized locally within their own dungeon.
Any Dungeon Maps & Compasses: Dungeon maps and compasses will be randomized locally within any dungeon.
Local Maps & Compasses: Dungeon maps and compasses will be randomized locally anywhere. (Without Archipelago, this is the same as Key-Lunacy.)
Key-Lunacy: Dungeon maps and compasses can be found anywhere, without restriction.

options.name: randomize_smallkeys
options.description: Controls how small keys are randomized.
choice_descriptions: Start With Small Keys: You will start the game with the small keys for all dungeons.
Vanilla Small Keys: Small keys will be kept in their vanilla location (non-randomized).
Own Dungeon Small Keys: Small keys will be randomized locally within their own dungeon.
Any Dungeon Small Keys: Small keys will be randomized locally within any dungeon.
Local Small Keys: Small keys will be randomized locally anywhere. (Without Archipelago, this is the same as Key-Lunacy.)
Key-Lunacy: Small keys can be found in any progression location, if dungeons are randomized.

options.name: randomize_bigkeys
options.description: Controls how big keys are randomized.
choice_descriptions: Start With Big Keys: You will start the game with the big keys for all dungeons.
Vanilla Big Keys: Big keys will be kept in their vanilla location (non-randomized).
Own Dungeon Big Keys: Big keys will be randomized locally within their own dungeon.
Any Dungeon Big Keys: Big keys will be randomized locally within any dungeon.
Local Big Keys: Big keys will be randomized locally anywhere. (Without Archipelago, this is the same as Key-Lunacy.)
Key-Lunacy: Big keys can be found in any progression location, if dungeons are randomized.

options.name: sword_mode
options.description:
Controls whether you start with the Hero's Sword, the Hero's Sword is randomized, or if there are no swords in the entire game.
Swordless and No Starting Sword are challenge modes. (For Swordless, Phantom Ganon at FF is vulnerable to Skull Hammer.)
choice_descriptions: Start with Hero's Sword: You will start the game with the basic Hero's Sword already in your inventory (the default).
No Starting Sword: You will start the game with no sword, and have to find it somewhere in the world like other randomized items.

You will start the game with no sword, but they'll still be randomized.
However, they are not necessary to beat the game as the Hyrule Barrier will be gone, Phantom Ganon in FF is vulnerable to Skull Hammer, and the logic not expect you to have a sword.

Swordless: You will start the game with no sword, and won't be able to find it anywhere. You have to beat the entire game using other items as weapons instead of the sword.
(Note that Phantom Ganon in FF becomes vulnerable to Skull Hammer in this mode.)

options.name: required_bosses
options.description:
In this mode, you will not be allowed to beat the game until certain randomly-chosen bosses are defeated. Nothing in dungeons for other bosses will ever be required.
You can see which islands have the required bosses on them by opening the sea chart and checking which islands have blue quest markers.

options.name: num_required_bosses
options.description:
Select the number of randomly-chosen bosses that are required in Required Bosses Mode.
The door to Puppet Ganon will not unlock until you've defeated all of these bosses. Nothing in dungeons for other bosses will ever be required.

options.name: included_dungeons
options.description: Dungeons whose bosses are always required in Required Bosses Mode.

options.name: excluded_dungeons
options.description: Dungeons whose bosses are never required in Required Bosses Mode.

options.name: chest_type_matches_contents
options.description: Changes the chest type to reflect its contents. A metal chest has a progress item, a wooden chest has a non-progress item or a consumable, and a green chest has a potentially required dungeon key.

options.name: trap_chests
options.description:
Allows the randomizer to place several trapped chests across the game that do not give you items.
Perfect for spicing up any run!

options.name: hero_mode
options.description: In Hero Mode, you take four times more damage than normal and heart refills will not drop.

options.name: logic_obscurity
options.description:
Obscure tricks are ways of obtaining items that are not obvious and may involve thinking outside the box.
This option controls the maximum difficulty of obscure tricks the randomizer will require you to do to beat the game.

options.name: logic_precision
options.description:
Precise tricks are ways of obtaining items that involve difficult inputs such as accurate aiming or perfect timing.
This option controls the maximum difficulty of precise tricks the randomizer will require you to do to beat the game.

options.name: enable_tuner_logic
options.description:
If enabled, the randomizer can logically expect the Tingle Tuner for Tingle Chests.
The randomizer behavior of logically expecting Bombs/bomb flowers to spawn in Tingle Chests remains unchanged.
Archipelago doesn't write this option into .aptww files, so for Archipelago seeds set it to match your world's settings yourself. (For those seeds it only affects the in-game tracker's logic.)

options.name: randomize_dungeon_entrances
options.description:
Shuffles around which dungeon entrances take you into which dungeons.
(No effect on Forsaken Fortress or Ganon's Tower.)

options.name: randomize_secret_cave_entrances
options.description: Shuffles around which secret cave entrances take you into which secret caves.

options.name: randomize_miniboss_entrances
options.description:
Allows dungeon miniboss doors to act as entrances to be randomized.
If this option is enabled with random dungeon entrances, dungeons may nest within each other, forming chains of connected dungeons.

options.name: randomize_boss_entrances
options.description:
Allows dungeon boss doors to act as entrances to be randomized.
If this option is enabled with random dungeon entrances, dungeons may nest within each other, forming chains of connected dungeons.

options.name: randomize_secret_cave_inner_entrances
options.description:
Allows the pit in Ice Ring Isle's secret cave and the rear exit out of Cliff Plateau Isles' secret cave to act as entrances to be randomized.
Only available when both Puzzle Secret Caves and Combat Secret Caves are progress locations.

options.name: randomize_fairy_fountain_entrances
options.description: Allows the pits that lead down into Fairy Fountains to act as entrances to be randomized.

options.name: mix_entrances
options.description: Controls whether dungeons should be separated from other randomized entrances, or if all types of randomized entrances can lead into each other.
choice_descriptions: Dungeon entrances will only be randomized to lead into other dungeons.
Dungeon entrances may be randomized to lead into areas that are not dungeons too.

options.name: randomize_enemy_palettes
options.description: Gives all the enemies in the game random colors.

options.name: randomize_starting_island
options.description: Randomizes which island you start the game on.

options.name: randomize_charts
options.description: Randomizes which sector is drawn on each Triforce/Treasure Chart.

options.name: hoho_hints
options.description: Places hints on Old Man Ho Ho. Old Man Ho Ho appears at 10 different islands in the game. Talk to Old Man Ho Ho to get hints.

options.name: fishmen_hints
options.description: Places hints on the fishmen. There is one fishman at each of the 49 islands of the Great Sea. Each fishman must be fed an All-Purpose Bait before he will give a hint.

options.name: korl_hints
options.description: Places hints on the King of Red Lions. Talk to the King of Red Lions to get hints.

options.name: num_item_hints
options.description:
The number of item hints that will be placed. Item hints tell you which area contains a particular progress item in this seed.
If multiple hint placement options are selected, the hint count will be split evenly among the placement options.

options.name: num_location_hints
options.description:
The number of location hints that will be placed. Location hints tell you what item is at a specific location in this seed.
If multiple hint placement options are selected, the hint count will be split evenly among the placement options.

options.name: num_barren_hints
options.description:
The number of barren hints that will be placed. Barren hints tell you that an area does not contain any required items in this seed.
If multiple hint placement options are selected, the hint count will be split evenly among the placement options.

options.name: num_path_hints
options.description:
The number of path hints that will be placed. Path hints tell you that an area contains an item that is required to reach a particular goal in this seed.
If multiple hint placement options are selected, the hint count will be split evenly among the placement options.

options.name: cryptic_hints
options.description: When this option is selected, all hints will be phrased cryptically instead of telling you the names of locations and items directly.

options.name: prioritize_remote_hints
options.description: When this option is selected, certain locations that are out of the way and time-consuming to complete will take precedence over normal location hints.

options.name: hint_importance
options.description:
When this option is selected, item and location hints will also indicate if the hinted item is required, possibly required, or not required.
Only progress items will have these additions; non-progress items are trivially not required.

options.name: swift_sail
options.description: Sailing speed is doubled and the direction of the wind is always at your back as long as the sail is out.

options.name: instant_text_boxes
options.description:
Text appears instantly.
Also, the B button is changed to instantly skip through text as long as you hold it down.

options.name: reveal_full_sea_chart
options.description: Start the game with the sea chart fully drawn out.

options.name: add_shortcut_warps_between_dungeons
options.description:
Adds new warp pots that act as shortcuts connecting dungeons to each other directly. (DRC, FW, TotG, and separately FF, ET, WT.)
Each pot must be unlocked before it can be used, so you cannot use them to access dungeons you wouldn't already have access to.

options.name: skip_rematch_bosses
options.description: Removes the door in Ganon's Tower that only unlocks when you defeat the rematch versions of Gohma, Kalle Demos, Jalhalla, and Molgera.

options.name: invert_camera_x_axis
options.description: Inverts the horizontal axis of camera movement.

options.name: invert_sea_compass_x_axis
options.description: Inverts the east-west direction of the compass that shows while at sea.

options.name: remove_title_and_ending_videos
options.description:
Removes the two prerendered videos that play if you wait on the title screen and after you beat the game. (This cuts the ISO's filesize in half.)
If you keep these videos in, they won't reflect your custom player model or colors.

options.name: remove_music
options.description: Mutes all ingame music.

options.name: switch_targeting_mode
options.description: Changes the default L-targeting mode when starting a new save file from 'Hold' to 'Switch'.

options.name: num_starting_triforce_shards
options.description:
Change the number of Triforce Shards you start the game with.
The higher you set this, the fewer you will need to find placed randomly to beat the game.

options.name: starting_pohs
options.description: Amount of extra pieces of heart that you start with.

options.name: starting_hcs
options.description: Amount of extra heart containers that you start with.

options.name: num_extra_starting_items
options.description:
Amount of extra random progression items that you start with.
Guaranteed to unlock at least one additional location at the start.

options.name: player_in_casual_clothes
options.description: Enable this if you want to wear your casual clothes instead of the Hero's Clothes.

options.name: disable_custom_player_voice
options.description: If the chosen custom model comes with custom voice files, you can check this option to turn them off and use Link's normal voice instead.

options.name: disable_custom_player_items
options.description: If the chosen custom model comes with custom item models, you can check this option to turn them off and use Link's normal item models instead.

options.name: in_game_tracker
options.description:
Adds a tracker to the sea chart that shows which locations you have checked and which are in logic, how many are left on each island and in each dungeon, where entrances you have gone through lead, and where the treasure charts you own point to.
It never shows what items are at locations. It works for both offline and Archipelago seeds and doesn't change item placement.

options.name: do_not_generate_spoiler_log
options.description:
Prevents the randomizer from generating a text file listing out the locations of all items in this seed. (Also changes where items are placed in this seed.)
Generating a spoiler log is highly recommended even if you don't intend to use it, just in case you get completely stuck.

options.name: dry_run
options.description:
If this option is selected, no playable ISO will be generated, but the log files will still be created.
This can be useful if you want to generate a spoiler log on a computer where you do not have a vanilla Wind Waker ISO.
